name: Altrad
verdict: Owned and chaired by its founder Mohed Altrad. Nothing found that passes the method.
note: Front-of-shirt sponsor of France (to 30 June 2027) and major sponsor of New Zealand Rugby and Montpellier Hérault Rugby. A 2022 first-instance corruption conviction of Mohed Altrad (Laporte-Altrad affair, appeal pending) and a 2026 tax-fraud investigation of the group are not human-rights records and fall in the categories METHOD.md excludes (bribery, tax), so they are not claimed.
